title: Ship catalog: 3 data-driven ship classes
description: Define the three v1 ship classes (scout, freighter, interceptor) as pure data in src/shared so both the server sim and the client UI render from the same source of truth.
acceptanceCriteria: src/shared/ships.ts exports SHIP_CLASSES: Record<ShipClassId, ShipClass> with ShipClassId = 'scout' | 'freighter' | 'interceptor'

ShipClass fields: {id, name, description, mass, maxVelocity (u/s), acceleration (u/s²), turnRate (rad/s), cargoSlots, maxWeight, weaponMounts: {laser: 1|2, missiles: 0|4}, shieldCapacity, hull, repairCostPerPoint, price (credits), liverySlots}

Stat balance sanity (asserted in tests): freighter has most cargo and lowest speed; interceptor has highest speed and missiles; scout is the middle starter; prices ascending scout < interceptor < freighter
Shared helpers: shipStats(classId) throws on unknown id; compareShips(a,b, key) for UI sorting
Unit tests: all three classes present, every stat is a positive finite number, cargoSlots >= 1, balance invariants hold

steps.details: Pick concrete numbers (document rationale in a comment header): scout {mass 20, maxVel 120, acc 40, turn 0.8, cargo 4, weight 40, laser 1, missiles 0, shield 50, hull 100, price 0 (starter)}; freighter {mass 120, maxVel 60, acc 12, turn 0.4, cargo 12, weight 240, laser 1, missiles 0, shield 80, hull 200, price 4000}; interceptor {mass 30, maxVel 180, acc 70, turn 1.2, cargo 2, weight 20, laser 2, missiles 4, shield 40, hull 80, price 2500}. Units are arbitrary sim units (u).
shipStats(id) with typed errors; totalWeaponCount(class); price lookup for dock UI. Keep the module pure (no imports).
Balance invariants, positive-finite stats, unknown-id throw. Run full suite + typecheck.

technicalNotes: These numbers feed TASK-22 (flight model), TASK-43 (weapons), and TASK-45 (AI roster class picks) — keep ids stable ('scout'|'freighter'|'interceptor').
Livery slots = 3 paint zones (hull, accent, trim) for TASK-21.
